title: Bleeding Heart Spells & Curses
description: A gothic storefront built into a dark brick building features a large weathered wooden sign reading 'BLEEDING HEART SPELLS & CURSES' with dripping white paint. Below it, a massive pink anatomical heart covered in stitches, symbols, and dripping white liquid is displayed on a deep red background, surrounded by candles, potion bottles, hanging tags, and scattered papers on a wet cobblestone street.
prompt: A moody atmospheric storefront at dusk built into an old dark brick building. A large weathered wooden sign with dripping paint reads 'BLEEDING HEART SPELLS & CURSES'. Below the sign is a giant pink anatomical heart covered in stitches, crosses, and dripping white liquid mounted on a deep red panel. The wooden shop front has candles, potion bottles, dried herbs, and paper tags hanging from it. Cobblestone street is wet and scattered with burnt papers, broken glass, and more tags. Dim atmospheric lighting with glowing candlelight, gothic fantasy style.
